title: Scheduled Downgrades, Term Changes and the Auto-Renew Switch on Web Hosting Plans
content:
**Support training note — Web Hosting Plans downgrades and term changes**

**The rule.** A downgrade or a term change is never applied mid-term; it is recorded as a scheduled request taking effect on the current term end date (on every tier a downgrade takes effect at the next renewal), and a newer request for the same plan replaces an older scheduled one. A downgrade that does not fit at renewal is declined and the plan renews on its current tier, and nothing already billed is refunded or credited by a downgrade. The customer may withdraw a scheduled request at any time before its effective date. Auto-renew may be switched on or off only while the plan status is provisioning, active or suspended.

**Fit clause — no longer in force.** The clause "A scheduled downgrade is applied at renewal only when the websites in use and the storage used fit within the target tier's websites allowance and storage" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current Web Hosting Plans renewal rules. The per-tier websites and storage figures, and the tier setting that a downgrade requires usage to fit, remain those of the specification sheet and the tier change paths.

**Questions the rule answers**

- *Can a downgrade start today?* No. It is scheduled and takes effect on the current term end date.
- *Two downgrade requests were made for one plan — which stands?* The newer request replaces the older scheduled one.
- *Does a downgrade refund part of the current term?* No. Nothing already billed is refunded or credited by a downgrade.
- *Can a scheduled request be withdrawn?* Yes, at any time before its effective date.
- *May auto-renew be switched off on a cancelled plan?* No. The switch may be changed only while the plan status is provisioning, active or suspended.

| Plan status | Auto-renew may be switched |
|---|---|
| provisioning | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| suspended | Yes |
| cancel-pending, cancelled or terminated | No |

superseded_clauses: A scheduled downgrade is applied at renewal only when websites_in_use and storage_used_gb fit within the target tier's max_websites and storage_gb.
